questions.q: According to Tolle, why can't religion save the world?
a: It already accepts suffering and carries part of the problem
It is too focused on science
questions.why: Lesson 1 says religions accept pain and chaos and so can't liberate us.

questions.q: What does the Zen story of Tanzan and Ekido illustrate?
questions.why: Lesson 2 uses it to teach against overthinking.

questions.q: What animal does Tolle compare a person who doesn't overthink to?
questions.why: Lesson 2 says be like a duck that quickly swims away after a fight.

questions.q: What does lesson 3 recommend doing in every moment?
a: Accept it as it is and act peacefully without judgment
questions.why: Lesson 3 says accept each moment as it is.

questions.q: What should be your motivation for doing things, per lesson 3?
a: Enjoyment rather than desire for material things
questions.why: The more you seek enjoyment, the more it becomes your source of motivation.
